dedupe_keys.name: multi source national forest inventory ms nfi maps of finland luke

description: The Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke) publishes the maps of its Multi-source National Forest Inventory (MS-NFI, MVMI in Finnish) through its INSPIRE download services. The 2023 MS-NFI results were published on 22 October 2025 as GeoTIFF rasters whose pixel values are forest variables, with special codes for forest pixels lacking satellite image cover and for non-forest pixels; the themes include biomass components by tree species (for example spruce living branches, waste wood and roots) along with other forest resource variables described in a separate theme file. Municipal forest resource tables for 2023 and for all earlier MS-NFI rounds are available as ZIP files, raster datasets can also be downloaded from the Paituli service, and INSPIRE Atom feeds serve the MS-NFI and species distribution datasets. The methods follow the published report on the MS-NFI of Finland for 2017 and 2019. The data are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, and access is free. Caveats: the page is mainly in Finnish, and the rasters are model estimates from satellite images and field plots. Coverage is Finland. It supports hazard exposure analysis, such as storm and snow damage risk to power lines and roads from adjacent forest, and wildfire fuel mapping; related records are ESA WorldCover and the Syke open spatial datasets.
